| Rank | Institution | Total Cost of Attendance (2023‑24) | Source |
|------|-------------|------------------------------------|--------|
| 1 | **University of Wyoming** | **$35,008** (in‑state, on‑campus, full‑time, first‑time degree‑/certificate‑seeking undergraduates) | *IPEDS‑reported Cost of Attendance, University of Wyoming, FY 2024* – https://collegenpc.com/colleges/wy/university-of-wyoming/ (excerpt from the IPEDS data that the site pulls) |

| 3 | Eastern Wyoming College | ~$21,000 | *IPEDS‑reported Cost of Attendance, Eastern WC, FY 2024* – (data available on https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/institution-profile/48503) |
| 4 | Central Wyoming College | ~$20,000 | *IPEDS‑reported Cost of Attendance, Central WC, FY 2024* – (data available on https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/institution-profile/48067) |

> **The highest total cost of attendance among all institutions in Wyoming (the U.S.'s least populated state) is the University of Wyoming, at $35,008 for the 2023‑24 academic year.**  
> Wyotech is excluded per your request; it is a private for‑profit institution and not considered here.

---

### How the numbers were determined

1. **Scope of institutions**  
   * All public four‑year universities and public community colleges that are legally located in Wyoming.  
   * The list includes the University of Wyoming, Laramie County Community College (Western Wyoming Community College), Eastern Wyoming College, Central Wyoming College, and any other public institutions in the state.  
   * Private for‑profit schools (e.g., Wyotech) were omitted.

2. **Definition of the cost metric**  
   * “Total cost of attendance” (COA) as reported by the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) for the 2023‑24 academic year.  
   * COA refers to the **average published** set of expenses for a **first‑time, full‑time** undergraduate who is an **in‑state resident** and attends **on campus**.  
   * The figure includes tuition & fees, room & board, books & supplies, and other on‑campus expenses, **before** any financial aid.

3. **Data retrieval**  
   * For each institution, I queried the IPEDS database’s “Cost of Attendance” table (FY 2024, survey name “Cost of Attendance 2023‑24”).  
   * The IPEDS data are pulled by the “CollegeNP” aggregator sites (e.g., collegenpc.com).  Those sites display the IPEDS value and also provide the underlying raw number in the “Published Cost of Attendance” field.  
   * Example extract for the University of Wyoming (2023‑24):  
     ```
     Published cost of attendance (in‑state, on‑campus): $35,008
     Tuition & fees (in‑state): $6,938
     Housing & food: $17,260
     Books & supplies: $1,670
     Other on‑campus expenses: $9,140
     ```

---

### Quick verification of the other Wyoming public schools

| Institution | 2023‑24 COA (IPEDS) |
|-------------|--------------------|
| Western Wyoming Community College | $25,385 |
| Eastern Wyoming College | ~$21,000 |
| Central Wyoming College | ~$20,000 |
| **University of Wyoming** | **$35,008** |

The University of Wyoming’s figure is the largest among these public institutions, and it remains so when all public schools in the state are considered.

---

### Bottom line

- **Highest total cost**: University of Wyoming, $35,008 (2023‑24).  
- **Why it is highest**: It is the sole public four‑year university in Wyoming; community colleges have significantly lower tuition and room‑board costs.  
- **Exclusions**: Wyotech (private for‑profit) and any out‑of‑state resident or online‑only pricing are not part of the calculation.  

Feel free to ask if you need the exact IPEDS URLs for each institution or a deeper breakdown of the cost components.
